verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents exporting your docs' files or a PDF from the Branch menu, plus export via tooling and its API. Bi-directional sync also keeps Markdown/MDX and OpenAPI files in your own GitHub/GitLab repo, which reduces lock-in at the content level. Nothing shows a rendered static-site bundle you can host anywhere, so self-hosting would mean rebuilding the site in another tool. Missing for 10: a deployable static HTML export of the full hub, documented self-hosting of exported output, and hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
